The '''''Scream of Ragnos''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] that was present during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Deceived" /> It was named after the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Marka Ragnos]].<ref name="Zosha Advance">{{TORcite|type=space|Zosha Advance}}</ref>
